symptom: A diagnostic BossHunterBot priority patch that ranked generic `boss-killer` and `high-risk` tags ahead of its original item ids made the repair v2 300s / 3-seed probe worse for the boss-focused lane. BossHunterBot fell from 33.3% win rate in the repair v2 baseline to 0.0%, while GreedyXpBot and KiteBot stayed at 100.0% and TankBot / ZoneControlBot stayed at 66.7%.
root_cause: The diagnostic patch made BossHunterBot pick high-risk burst identity earlier, but the current Demo buildcraft pool does not provide enough survival, mobility, cooldown, or crowd-control prerequisites before those picks. This turns boss-focus into early fragility instead of a reliable boss-killer build. The remaining mid-skill overperformance is also independent, so a generic tag-priority patch cannot solve both sides of the repair.
fix: Do not keep or promote the diagnostic BossHunterBot priority patch. The next repair should keep boss-killer recognition survival-aware: preserve early mobility/cooldown/safety prerequisites, only prefer high-risk burst after the build has enough survivability, and separately tune Greedy/Kite/Tank/ZoneControl over-stability through candidate numbers or wave pressure.
validation: After the next repair, rerun the same 300s all-bot matrix on frosting-grassland seeds 70000-70002 and compare against the repair v2 baseline and this boss-tag diagnostic. BossHunterBot should return to the high-skill target band without pushing GreedyXpBot, KiteBot, TankBot, or ZoneControlBot outside their target ranges.
